CustomField.description: API name of the autolaunched Flow that builds/updates the Account during conversion. The Form_Submission_Convert__e trigger resolves it (namespace-tolerant), confirms it is an active autolaunched Flow with a Form_Submission_Convert__e input variable, and invokes it. Blank uses the package's default Account conversion Flow.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Advanced override: API name of the Flow that creates or updates the Account when a submission converts. Leave blank to use the default Account conversion Flow.
CustomField.label: FlowApiName (Account)
